goal: Scale Chu-kei's Universe-first Plan Detection coverage through multiple bounded non-public candidate batches, prioritizing company-count coverage over deep-detail completeness. PR #246 / ade-batch-001 is already merged; treat all existing candidate batches, registry/queue/override files, research-priority outputs, public frontend data, quality-rebase reviews, patches, source-research records, reports, package/workflow configuration, and publication state as read-only. Use operations/research-priority/current-v1.json and the Plan Detection registry/queue as selection inputs. Select distinct highest-priority companies that are still not_checked and are not already present in any existing candidate batch; explicitly exclude 130A, 135A, and 137A because they are in ade-batch-001. Work in small batches of about 3 companies per task, creating only new batch evidence under operations/plan-detection/candidates/ with unique batch IDs beginning at ade-batch-002. Research only official or first-party primary sources. Preserve source/document identity, publication date, plan/version/period/fiscal semantics, checked time, currentness boundaries, evidence provenance, and explicit review-needed state. Never infer no_formal_plan from missing evidence; never convert annual forecasts, long-term visions, growth strategies, or policy statements into a formal medium-term plan without explicit evidence. All candidates must remain non-public, human-review pending, automatic promotion disabled, publication ineligible, and final registry mutation forbidden. Do not change current/verified/reviewed status, Deep Verification, human-review decisions, production promotion, rankings, or evaluative claims. For every task run the existing node scripts/validate_plan_detection_candidates_v1.mjs validator and npm run quality:v43 before PR. Continue across distinct batches within this campaign while safe high-priority not_checked candidates remain. Success is a sequence of green bounded PRs that expands reusable primary-source Plan Detection evidence without changing published Plan Detection state.
